subject: Uptime safety net proposal for Avalon AI - credit & trial extension
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@avalonai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected spikes and service drop: December 1

Hi Olga,

Quick escalation from our side — between 09:08 and 09:26 PST this morning we saw sustained latency spikes (p95 > 3.2s, token generation timeouts on a subset of requests) and approximately 18% request failures for our inference route using rwd-llama-large. This impacted our customer-facing inference for the Avalon Search product; the incident caused 2 support tickets and one customer-facing incident banner.

I've attached our incident log and the billing usage export for the window. Can you confirm what happened on your side and whether this will be considered for compensation? We are near the end of our paid trial and are evaluating whether to expand — given the impact, we're requesting a goodwill credit for the impacted billing window and a short trial extension so we can finish our load validation run without further risk.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Jensen
VP, Platform Operations
Avalon AI
ops@avalonai.com

Attachments: incident-log-2026-12-01.txt (text), billing-usage-report-avalon.csv (csv)

Marissa / Sean / Markus — forwarding Avalon AI's escalation. Key facts from their logs: 09:08–09:26 PST, elevated p95 and ~18% errors on the rwd-llama-large route. They attach the incident log and our billing window. They are a mid-sized customer finishing paid trial; potential expansion (DL-4729) is live next quarter.

What I'm proposing: 1) a goodwill credit equivalent to the prorated usage for the impacted window (rough estimate $7.8k) OR a 25% invoice credit for December; 2) a 14-day paid trial extension to allow them to finish validation; 3) a short post-incident review with the customer and our infra team (Sean) to confirm root cause and mitigation.

Please confirm approval to apply the credit and the voucher text for the trial extension. I'll coordinate messaging and apply the credit once finance OKs it.

Subject: Resolution: credit applied + 14-day trial extension for Avalon AI

Hi Sara — thanks again for sending the logs. We completed our internal review and appreciate your patience. Summary and remediation below: 

What happened: During the 09:08–09:26 PST window on Dec 1, our runtime routing experienced an elevated tail-latency event while a kernel selector update rolled out to the west-coast pool. This caused increased scheduling delays for a subset of real-time requests. Sean's team will walk through the mitigation steps in the postmortem.

What we've done for Avalon AI:
- Account credit: $7,800 (CREDIT-AV-4729) has been applied to your account and will appear on your next invoice as a negative line item.
- Trial extension: a 14-day trial voucher has been issued. Voucher code: RED-TRIAL-14-AVALON. To redeem, log into the Console > Account > Billing > Enter voucher.
- Postmortem: Sean Gallagher (cc) will reach out to schedule a 30-minute call to review the root cause and action items.

Attachments: trial-extension-voucher.txt (voucher and redemption steps), incident-log-2026-12-01.txt (annotated by our infra team)

If you'd like a formal credit memo or a short write-up for your procurement team, I can have finance generate that (Markus, will follow up).

Best,
